segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Thank you all for coming to my talk this evening.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It's nice to see so many people in the audience.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: For those of you who don't know very much about PS Camping, let me start by giving you some background information about the company.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The company started twenty-five years ago.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It actually opened as a retail chain selling camping equipment, and then twenty years ago, it bought a small number of campsites in the UK, and began offering camping holidays.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The company grew rapidly and has been providing holidays in continental Europe for the last fifteen years.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you book a camping holiday with us, you'll have a choice of over three hundred sites.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In Italy we now have some 64 sites that we either own, or have exclusive use of.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: France is where we have the majority of sites, and we currently have a project to expand into Switzerland.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We also have a number of sites in Northern Spain, particularly in the mountainous region of Picos de Europa.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We've upgraded all these Spanish sites, and improved them considerably from their original three-star rating.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We believe our holidays offer superb facilities for the whole family.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Parents who want their children to be fully occupied for all or part of the day can take advantage of our children's activities.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: These are organised by our well-qualified and enthusiastic staff.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Each day kicks off with a sports match, perhaps football, or volleyball, followed by an hour of drama for everyone.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This may include singing or dancing, mime or other activities.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In the afternoon, there's a different art activity for each day of the week including a poster competition or model making.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: What's more, our sites are truly child-friendly, and, with this in mind, we operate a no-noise rule in the evenings.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Children's evening activities usually finish at 9.30, or occasionally 10, and from I 0.30 holiday-makers are expected to be quiet in the areas where there are tents.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We want nothing to go wrong on a PS Camping holiday, but if it does, we also want all customers to be insured.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you haven't organised an annual insurance policy of your own you'll need to take out the low-cost cover we offer and we require that you arrange this when you make your holiday reservation.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are many advantages to choosing PS Camping, and to recommending it to others.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As a regular customer, you'll be kept informed of special offers, and your friends can benefit from ten per cent off their holiday, or book a luxury tent for the price of a standard one.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In return, we'll send you a thank-you present, which you can choose from a list of high-quality items.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: When it comes to our tents, these are equipped to the highest standard.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We really do think of every essential detail, from an oven and cooking rings fuelled by bottled gas, to mirrors in the bedroom areas.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you don't want to cook indoors, you can borrow a barbecue if you ask in advance for one to be made available, and there's even a picnic blanket to sit on outside your tent.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Inside, a box of games and toys can be found, and children's tents can be hired if required.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: All tents have a fridge, and if you want to spend the day on the beach, for , ask for a specially designed PS Camping cool box, which will keep your food and drinks chilled.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There are excellent washing facilities at all our sites, with washing machines and clothes lines in the central areas, along with mops and buckets in case your tent needs cleaning during your stay.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: All sites have a cafe and/or a shop for those who'd rather 'eat in' than dine at a local restaurant.
